# Boston Globe

> The Boston Globe is New England's leading news source covering breaking news, sports, metro coverage, investigations, and local communities across Massachusetts.

The Boston Globe provides comprehensive coverage of Boston and New England news including professional sports (Red Sox, Patriots, Bruins), local metro news, politics, education, transportation, and investigative journalism. The site also features games and puzzles for daily entertainment.

## Key Topics

- Boston sports (Red Sox, Patriots, Bruins)
- Massachusetts politics and state legislature
- New England regional news
- Boston metro and local news
- Breaking news and investigations
- Education and schools coverage
- MBTA and transportation
- Weather forecasts
- Women's sports (WNBA, PWHL, NWSL)
- College sports
- High school sports (MIAA)
- Crime and public safety
- Cambridge and Somerville
- Games and puzzles

## News & Breaking Updates

- [The Boston Globe](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com): Boston Globe homepage with breaking news, analysis, and subscription options
- [Metro - The Boston Globe](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com/metro): Boston and New England metro news with breaking updates and local coverage
- [Investigations | The Boston Globe](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com/metro/investigations): Globe investigations: Epstein, Harvard, homelessness, government misconduct

## Sports Coverage

- [Boston Globe sports news - NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL scores and schedule](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com/sports): Sports hub covering NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL with Boston teams focus
- [Boston Red Sox news - The Boston Globe](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com/sports/baseball/redsox): Red Sox news, scores, stats, standings, and player updates
- [New England Patriots news - The Boston Globe](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com/sports/football/patriots): Patriots football news, draft, free agency, and team roster coverage
- [Boston Bruins news - The Boston Globe](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com/sports/hockey/bruins): Bruins NHL news, scores, standings, and hockey coverage
- [College sports news from the Boston Globe](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com/sports/colleges): College sports news including March Madness and New England teams
- [Women's sports news - The Boston Globe](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com/sports/women): Women's sports coverage: WNBA, PWHL, NWSL, Olympics, and more
- [Massachusetts high school sports - MIAA news, scores, rankings from Boston Globe](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com/sports/high-schools): MIAA high school sports news, rankings, scores, and standings
- [Boston sports TV listings from the Boston Globe](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com/sports/tv-radio): Boston sports TV schedule, channels, and radio station listings

## Local News & Community

- [Politics - The Boston Globe](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com/metro/politics): Massachusetts politics, state senate, elections, and political news
- [The Great Divide - Race, class, and opportunity in Boston schools](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com/metro/education): Boston schools investigation: race, class, inequality, and education
- [Transportation - The Boston Globe](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com/metro/transportation): Boston transportation news: MBTA, airports, traffic, and road updates
- [Around Massachusetts](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com/metro/new-england/massachusetts): Massachusetts regional news from across the state and New England
- [Cambridge & Somerville News | The Boston Globe](https://bostonglobe-prod.cdn.arcpublishing.com/metro/new-england/massachusetts/cambridge-somerville): Cambridge and Somerville local news and community updates
